sourceFile: 48. BRS-2015 Report Test New BP+SM ass'y machine date 29.5.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the likely machine comparison but outcome grouping and citations are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed-factor domain is overbroad; evidence supports mainly new machine versus normal machine.
Measurement outcomes use generic columns and cite header/unclear rows instead of verifiable data rows.
Tension, drop, and separate-glue results are not properly captured as outcome comparisons.
Key result rows 37-46 are missing or underused in outcome evidence.
Row 34 is cited but not shown in context, limiting verification.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to equipment/process comparison: Normal machine vs New machine.
Rebuild outcomes for tension, drop test, separate glue, and function under the same changed factor.
Cite actual result rows for each outcome, including rows 37-46 and 50/52 as applicable.
Remove or relabel unverifiable generic measurement statistics unless raw rows support them.
Keep function NG-rate comparison but note unequal sample quantities if judging improvement.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; each outcome needs direct cited result rows, not only headers or unseen rows.
